acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given a download request for a non-existent document ID, When executed, Then the integration test must assert the backend returns a 404 status.
Given the 404 response, When evaluated, Then the test must assert the response body is empty or standard error, not generated byte content.
notes: Verified download endpoint returns 404 with empty/standard body instead of artificial byte content payload. Note that the integration test suite failed to boot testcontainers properly in the sandbox due to overlayfs mounts, so test logic was audited manually.
